definitions.explanation: The seven vertebrae of the neck, at the top of the spinal column. Familiar to most people from injuries such as whiplash and from disc problems.

examples.japanese: {頚椎|けいつい}を{痛|いた}めた。
{頚椎|けいつい}のレントゲンを{撮|と}ってもらった。
examples.english: I had an X-ray taken of my cervical spine.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}のあと{手|て}のしびれが{続|つづ}き、{頚椎|けいつい}の{異常|いじょう}が{見|み}つかった。
examples.english: The numbness in my hands continued after the accident, and a problem was found in my cervical spine.

notes:
WRITING:
Also written {頸椎|けいつい}. {頸|けい} is the form used in medical writing, while {頚|けい} is the simplified variant common in everyday text; both are read けいつい.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頚椎|けいつい}を{痛|いた}める: to injure one's cervical spine
- {頚椎|けいつい}{損傷|そんしょう}: cervical spine injury
- {頚椎|けいつい}ヘルニア: cervical disc herniation
- {頚椎|けいつい}ねんざ: neck sprain, whiplash

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {背骨|せぼね}: the backbone — the everyday word for the spine as a whole
- {腰椎|ようつい}: lumbar vertebrae — the lower back section
